column2: The conservative approximation K_e = 1.00 is permitted in all cases.

The factor K_e shall be determined from the above table using interpolation or from the following formula for all elevations: K_e = e^(-0.0000362 * z_g) (z_g = ground elevation above sea level in ft) or K_e = e^(-0.000119 * z_g) (z_g = ground elevation above sea level in m).
